title: Code for: Beyond presence and absence: a survey of TOR and AMPK across 210 eukaryotes reveals unusually long coccidian AMPKγ
description: The code of the eleven methods that are new in this study and that produce the data of its main results: search settings chosen jointly against declared controls and decoys, a gene-tree clade criterion anchored on curated controls, the re-examination of absences, the TOR N-terminal HEAT calls, the sequence measurements of the retained AMPK subunits and of the coccidian AMPKγ copies, the AMP-site geometry of predicted structures, penalised phylogenetic logistic regression with a multistart search, the models of the AMPKα C-terminal tail, the upstream-kinase classification, and the ancestral-state reconstructions. docs/CODE_MAP.md maps every table and figure of the article to this code, and docs/SOFTWARE.md gives the version and settings of every program the study used.
